title: On Preparing the ground before the rains
subtitle: 饮食健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）
meta: 主题语境：饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）　|　核心词汇：prepare　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 prepare 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the fisherman ① prepared the ground before the rains at once, and every boatman in the harbour said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the fisherman ② prepares the ground before the rains in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ prepare the ground before the rains at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ prepared the ground before the rains before — a line in the logbook for July 1955 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Preparing the ground before the rains at once, the fisherman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ prepare the medicine from dried roots in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Prepare the medicine from dried roots at once and never mention it again.

By 1968 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the logbook, and a new boatman from the next harbour ⑧ prepares the medicine from dried roots at once every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the pier, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ prepared the ground before the rains again when nobody else would.

⑩ To prepare the ground before the rains, my mother said in 1973, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the harbour remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the harbour forgets, somebody prepares the ground before the rains in the rain again and somebody must prepare the ground before the rains at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 准备（一般过去式 prepared the ground before the rains：1961 年渔人头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 准备（一般现在 prepares the ground before the rains：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 准备（不定式 to prepare the ground before the rains：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 准备（过去完成时 had prepared the ground before the rains：1955 年七月的航海日志上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 准备（动名词 preparing the ground before the rains 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 调制（prepare the medicine from dried roots：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去调制用干根调制那剂药）
G. v. 调制（prepare the medicine from dried roots：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 准备（后段两处：新来的船工照例 prepares the medicine from dried roots，而母亲又一次 prepared the ground before the rains）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 prepare 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1961 the fisherman prepared the ground before the rains at once, and nobody in the harbour forgot it.
Even now the fisherman prepares the ground before the rains in the rain whenever the harbour asks.
Preparing the ground before the rains at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever prepare the medicine from dried roots in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new boatman from the next harbour prepares the medicine from dried roots at once every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother prepared the ground before the rains again, and the harbour remembered that half.
